description: This file is a PHP source file for a controller class within an OpenCart e-commerce platform extension. It manages marketplace events in the admin panel, providing methods for listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting events, along with handling HTTP requests, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace events in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the core Controller class and providing CRUD operations with permission checks and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the event list page with filters and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to load the list of events.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the data needed for displaying the list of events, including filtering, pagination, and view rendering.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected events; checks permissions and returns JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected events; checks permissions and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected events; checks permissions and returns JSON response.
